keyEvents.text: Goal! Mainz 0, Bayern Munich 1. Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) right footed shot from outside the box to the top right corner. Assisted by Harry Kane.
Delay in match because of an injury Manuel Neuer (Bayern Munich).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Bayern Munich. Jonas Urbig replaces Manuel Neuer because of an injury.
First Half ends, Mainz 0, Bayern Munich 1.
Second Half begins Mainz 0, Bayern Munich 1.
Goal! Mainz 0, Bayern Munich 2. Lennart Karl (Bayern Munich) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Harry Kane.
Substitution, Mainz. Phillip Tietz replaces Ransford Königsdörffer.
Substitution, Mainz. Paul Nebel replaces Lee Jae-Sung.
Substitution, Bayern Munich. Tom Bischof replaces Lennart Karl.
Substitution, Bayern Munich. Alphonso Davies replaces Josip Stanisic.
Substitution, Mainz. Benedict Hollerbach replaces Sheraldo Becker.
Substitution, Mainz. Rael Nakuzola replaces Silvan Widmer.
Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Mainz. Eric Martel replaces Anthony Caci.
Substitution, Bayern Munich. Hiroki Ito replaces Konrad Laimer.
